/help
Getting started
Type a task and press Enter.
/model  Choose a model
/connect  Add a connection
/help  Explore all commands

Primary
/help  List commands and keys
/goal [OBJECTIVE | edit … | budget N | pause
 | resume | clear]  Inspect or control a mu
lti-turn goal
/context [NAME|default]  Show context usage
 or choose a window
/status [--verbose]  Show session, usage, a
nd workspace status
/model [PROVIDER/MODEL]  Switch model
/details  Toggle bounded live tool detail
/timeline  Show local turn, child, and reco
very history
/new  Start a fresh session
/resume [ID]  Resume a saved session
/connect [PROVIDER]  Connect or reconnect a
 provider
/disconnect [PROVIDER]  Disconnect a provid
er
/think [on|off|default]  Set thinking for t
he next turn
/effort [LEVEL|default]  Set reasoning effo
rt for the next turn
/account [N]  Show provider accounts and th
eir usage
/agent [ID|resume ID]  List, inspect, or re
sume an existing agent
/mcp [trust NAME]  Show MCP servers, or tru
st one so it may run
/skills [trust NAME]  Show indexed skills,
or trust one this project ships
/diff [SCOPE]  Inspect workspace changes
/review [SCOPE]  Run a read-only change rev
iew
/undo  Undo the last attributable turn
/redo  Reapply the newest exact undone turn
/revert [FILE]  Selectively revert a file o
r hunk

Advanced
/diagnostics  Show detailed cache and recov
ery diagnostics
/profile [NAME]  Switch configured profile
/provider [NAME]  Switch provider
/quit  Exit Smith

Composer
? or /help shows this local guide without co
ntacting the model.
Tab cycles the configured profile order only
 while empty and idle.
While work is serving, Enter steers an ordin
ary prompt and Tab queues it.
Alt+Up restores the newest explicit queued t
urn for editing.
Esc interrupts; uncommitted steers are resen
t only after cancellation discards them.
Ctrl+B moves a running foreground shell comm
and to the background without killing it.
@ completes exact files and read-only agents
; @@ sends a literal @.
! runs a prepared local shell action; !! sen
ds a literal !.
PageUp/PageDown/Home/End or the mouse wheel
scrolls the transcript.
Up/Down browse accepted and Ctrl+C-stashed i
nput without losing your draft.
Down past the newest draft walks the delegat
ed agents; the transcript shows
that agent's log, Enter continues it, and Es
c returns to the root timeline.
Ctrl+R searches composer history; Enter rest
ores a match and Esc cancels.
Ctrl+C twice within 1s exits; the first pres
s stashes and clears the draft.
Start a message with // to send a literal le
ading slash.
